abort.no_devices_found: No Fluval Smart lights were found nearby.

init.title: Light schedule
init.description: Choose which on-device schedule to edit. The light runs these by itself, against its own clock, while it is in Auto or Pro mode.

auto.title: Auto schedule
auto.description: The light fades from night to day brightness over the sunrise window, and back to night brightness over the sunset window. Brightness is a percentage per LED channel.

data.turnoff_enabled: Turn off at a fixed time
data.activate: Switch the light to Auto mode after saving

pro_points.title: Pro schedule
pro_points.description: How many points should the daily schedule have? Brightness is interpolated between consecutive points.

pro.title: Pro schedule
pro.description: Set the time of day and per-channel brightness (%) for each of the {count} points. They are sorted by time before being sent to the light.

data.activate: Switch the light to Pro mode after saving

error.sunrise_order: Sunrise must start before it ends.
error.sunset_order: Sunset must start before it ends.
error.sunrise_after_sunset: Sunrise must end before sunset starts.
error.duplicate_times: Each point needs a different time of day.
error.cannot_connect: Could not send the schedule to the light. Make sure it is powered on and in Bluetooth range, then try again.

abort.not_loaded: The light isn't currently connected. Wait for it to finish setting up, then try again.
